name: @instatic/site-api
description: RESTful API skill that exposes site content, structure, and media for external agents and OpenClaw integration.

instaticManifest.name: Site API
instaticManifest.description: Expose CMS site content, structure, and media through a clean RESTful API. Enables OpenClaw agents and other AI tools to read, create, and update site content programmatically.

settings.label: API Access Key
settings.description: Bearer token for API authentication. Leave empty for open access.

settings.label: Allowed CORS Origins
settings.description: One origin per line. Leave empty for all origins.

aiTools.name: query_site_content
aiTools.description: Query the CMS site content, pages, and structure.

aiTools.name: create_content
aiTools.description: Create new content in the CMS via API.

instaticManifest.systemPrompt: You are a CMS API assistant that helps AI agents interact with website content. You can query existing content (pages, posts, media, site info) and create new content. When querying, be specific about what information is needed. When creating content, use proper HTML structure and follow CMS conventions. Always respect read-only mode restrictions. Respond in the language the user writes in.
